items.statement: Titan's domestic jewellery business grew by approximately 38% year-over-year to ₹15,502 crores, driven by strong demand during Akshaya Tritiya and wedding purchases.
items.quote: Business grew c.38% YoY to ₹15,502 crores, led by healthy Akshaya Tritiya demand and supported by wedding led purchases during the quarter

items.statement: The domestic watches division achieved a 22% year-over-year growth, reaching ₹1,510 crores, propelled by premiumization in analog watches.
items.quote: Domestic Watches business delivered a healthy growth of c.22% YoY to ₹1,510 crores, led by continuing premiumization trends in the analog segment

items.statement: Titan's domestic EyeCare business grew by about 22% year-over-year to ₹285 crores, supported by strong performance in both owned and international brands.
items.quote: EyeCare's domestic business delivered c.22% YoY growth to ₹285 crores, reflecting broad - based momentum across both owned and international brand portfolios

items.statement: Geopolitical disruptions in the GCC region negatively impacted consumer demand, though the business is beginning to show signs of recovery.
items.quote: Consumer demand across GCC was impacted by geopolitical disruptions in the region ; Notwithstanding the above, business is showing early signs of gradual recovery across key operating parameters

items.statement: Smart watch sales experienced a single-digit year-over-year decline as the division recalibrates the category to focus on sustainable unit economics.
items.quote: Smart Watches declined in single - digits YoY, reflecting an ongoing category recalibration as the division continues to focus on sustainable unit economics

items.statement: The emerging businesses segment of the company posted a total loss of ₹39 crores for the quarter.
items.quote: The Emerging Businesses portfolio reported a combined loss of ₹39 crores during the quarter

items.statement: The domestic jewellery business experienced strong demand driven by Akshaya Tritiya and wedding-related purchases.
items.quote: Business grew c.38% YoY to ₹15,502 crores, led by healthy Akshaya Tritiya demand and supported by wedding led purchases during the quarter

items.statement: Taneira's revenue growth was flat year-over-year, even though underlying consumer demand remained healthy.
items.quote: Taneira reported flattish YoY growth, with underlying consumer (secondary) demand remaining healthy.

items.statement: Ongoing premiumization across the EyeCare portfolio led to double-digit year-over-year growth in average selling prices.
items.quote: Premiumisation remained a visible trend across the portfolio, contributing to a double - digit growth in average selling prices YoY

items.statement: Analog watches drove growth for the division with mid-twenties percentage increases, supported by both volume growth and higher average selling prices.
items.quote: Analog watches remained the core growth engine for the Division, clocking growth in the mid twenties YoY, driven by healthy contributions from both volume uptake and average selling price expansion

items.statement: A sharp rise in customs duty from 6% to 15% occurred during the quarter, which Tanishq managed through exchange-led offers to maintain customer footfalls.
items.quote: Amid a steep increase in customs duty from 6% to 15% (effective May 13, 2026), Tanishq's attractive exchange - led proposition anchored footfalls and conversions

items.statement: The domestic jewellery business recorded an EBIT margin of 14.2%, which normalizes to 11.7% after adjusting for a ₹386 crore benefit from the customs duty hike.
items.quote: EBIT came in at ₹2,202 crores at 14.2% margin ; Adjusting for ₹386 crores of benefit in realization due to the custom duty increase, the resultant EBIT was ₹1,816 crores at 11.7% margin

items.statement: TEAL's EBIT margin reached approximately 33%, though it is not fully comparable to previous quarters due to seasonal factors in the Automation Solutions business.
items.quote: The EBIT margin came in at ₹143 Cr at c.33% margin. The margins are not fully comparable to earlier quarters on account of significant seasonality impact in the Automation Solutions business

items.statement: CaratLane launched 'Shaya Diamonds', which is India's first collection of natural diamonds set in 925 silver to increase accessibility.
items.quote: Introduced 'Shaya Diamonds', India's first collection featuring natural diamonds set in 925 silver, making natural diamonds more accessible

items.statement: Titan entered the global luxury watchmaking stage by showcasing the Titan Edge Ultraslim Mechanical and Nebula Genesis at Watches & Wonders Geneva 2026.
items.quote: Debuted at Watches & Wonders Geneva 2026, showcasing the Titan Edge Ultraslim Mechanical and Nebula Genesis, marking Titan's entry onto the global luxury watchmaking stage

items.statement: The company launched 'Amalfi' to introduce Mediterranean-inspired luxury fragrances to India's premium perfume market.
items.quote: Introduced 'Amalfi', bringing Mediterranean - inspired luxury fragrances to the Indian premium perfume market

items.statement: Management highlighted risks and challenges during the quarter, including volatile gold prices, sudden duty structure changes, and geopolitical headwinds in international markets.
items.quote: The broad - based performance notwithstanding, the quarter demanded significant agility on multiple fronts from navigating gold prices to the sharp changes in the duty structure and to managing geopolitical headwinds across our international operations.

items.statement: Despite geopolitical disruptions in the GCC region, the Damas business is showing early signs of a gradual recovery across key operating parameters.
items.quote: Notwithstanding the above, business is showing early signs of gradual recovery across key operating parameters

items.statement: Taneira is focusing on improving its same-store performance before it accelerates its retail network expansion.
items.quote: The brand continues to focus on strengthening same - store performance ahead of accelerating network expansion

items.statement: Titan's four-decade journey has helped shape India's watch industry and build consumer trust, as depicted in a feature film on Amazon Prime Video.
items.quote: The feature film Made in India: A Titan Story (aired on Amazon Prime Video) brought to life Titan's four - decade journey of resilience, innovation and craftsmanship that helped shape India's watch industry earning enduring consumer trust

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Notwithstanding the above, business is showing early signs of gradual recovery across key operating parameters

items.statement: Titan experienced comprehensive growth across all of its brands, businesses, and subsidiaries, alongside positive volume and buyer growth.
items.quote: We've seen all-round growth across all our businesses, all our brands, subsidiaries. And we've also seen a good volume growth and a buyer growth that has come in.

items.statement: The company observed a continued recovery and growth in its studded jewellery segment during the first quarter.
items.quote: No. As you are aware, we have - we began seeing a resurgence of studded in Quarter 4 of last year, and we are seeing that continue to play out in Quarter 1.

items.statement: CaratLane experienced record performance during the second half of May and throughout June.
items.quote: In fact, May second half and June has been kind of a record kind of a performance that we saw.

items.statement: Consumer sentiment experienced a temporary period of softness lasting approximately three weeks until the end of May.
items.quote: As a consequence, we did see a softness in consumer sentiment for about 3 weeks' time till the end of May.

items.statement: Geopolitical conflict has negatively impacted jewellery purchasing priorities and footfalls in Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and other countries.
items.quote: But given the current situation of war, I think purchasing jewellery in Dubai and Saudi and other countries is the last priority for anyone there.

items.statement: The company experienced a 40 basis point decline in its gross margin.
items.quote: But still eventually, there is a 40 basis point erosion of GC margin.

items.statement: Management has observed positive growth trends in the first four months of the fiscal year, including July.
items.quote: And the growth, what we have seen in Quarter 1, and we are also seeing that July also is not bad. So, I'm seeing a certain positivity so far in the last 4 months.

items.statement: The company expects to meet its long-term growth targets and potentially exceed them in the current fiscal year.
items.quote: We think we are on trajectory for delivering the kind of growths that we had promised in the Investor Day. And we hope that we can, in fact, better it in the current year because we've started very well.

items.statement: Titan expects its overall international portfolio to achieve positive EBIT performance for the full year.
items.quote: And overall, Damas contribution in international business will not be very high. So I would expect overall portfolio would still turn out to be positive EBIT performance for the full year.

items.statement: The company maintains its guidance of around 11% as the central margin target for its jewellery business.
items.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.

items.statement: Titan is targeting aggressive double-digit growth for its business.
items.quote: If you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.

items.statement: The long-term normalized margin for TEAL is expected to gradually move towards a range of 12% to 16%.
items.quote: overall, long term, growth is on a very strong wicket, but the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.

items.statement: Wedding-related demand resumed after the conclusion of Adhik Maas, leading to a recovery in June.
items.quote: Weddings also restarted post the end of Adhik Maas. So we believe that it was a deferment and we saw things pick up in June.

items.statement: The company noticed some softness in demand for plain gold jewellery towards the end of July.
items.quote: the only point to add to what we've already spoken of is I think in the -- towards the end of July, perhaps we did see some softness in -- on the plain gold side, okay?

items.statement: High gold prices over the past couple of years have caused buyer growth to slow down.
items.quote: I think we have seen buyer growth actually taper down in the last couple of years because gold prices went up dramatically.

items.statement: Gold prices have been highly volatile and uncertain, experiencing sudden and significant daily fluctuations.
items.quote: Gold prices continue to remain on a very uncertain trajectory. You would have seen softening then all of a sudden in a day, $100, $200 going up and down.

items.statement: The pricing for natural diamonds, including solitaires and smaller diamonds, has shown increased stability.
items.quote: Natural diamond prices. Yes, we have seen more stability perhaps in the pricing, both of solitaires as well as small diamonds.

items.statement: Titan benefited from a customs duty rate increase on gold from 6% to 15% during the quarter.
items.quote: We had during this quarter, gains on account of customs duty rate increase from 6% to 15%.

items.statement: Titan advanced its gold procurement to ensure adequate supply for festive demand and production.
items.quote: And we were also advancing our gold procurement to secure that we are fully equipped to meet our festive demand and production without any disruptions.

items.statement: The company purchased a significant amount of gold during a period of wide price gaps between international and domestic markets.
items.quote: And we ended up procuring quite a bit gold at that point of time.

items.statement: The watch division performs a standard costing revaluation of its watch inventory during the first quarter of every fiscal year.
items.quote: But every quarter 1, we run standard costing revaluation of inventory of watches.

items.statement: The normalized EBIT margin for the Tanishq, Mia, and Zoya portfolio stood at 10.9% for the quarter.
items.quote: So the normalized margin considering both custom duty gain and MTM gain, the normalized EBIT margin for our Tanishq Mia Zoya business would be 10.9%, the number for this quarter.

items.statement: The normalized EBIT margin for the watch division was 17.8% in the current quarter compared to 18.6% in the same quarter of the previous year.
items.quote: So if you normalize for both these sides, then last Quarter 1 FY '26 watch EBIT margin was 18.6% compared to 17.8% normalized margin for this quarter.

items.statement: CaratLane is expected to gradually improve its profitability toward a double-digit EBIT margin.
items.quote: As far as CaratLane is concerned, we have always said they will gradually go towards double-digit EBIT margin, more like Tanishq kind of margin it's there.

items.statement: Titan introduced a cash-for-gold exchange program across all its retail stores starting in June.
items.quote: We have rolled out what we had called as cash for gold in all our stores from the month of June.

items.statement: Customers are increasingly choosing the Rivaah Golden Advantage scheme over the Golden Harvest program due to its rupee cost averaging benefits.
items.quote: What's really happening is the dynamic between the 2 where we are seeing most customers prefer Rivaah Golden Advantage because it helps in the rupee cost averaging.

items.statement: The company is implementing several gross margin initiatives, including lower caratage offerings, the GC Max program, and new sourcing strategies.
items.quote: No, I don't think we are going into that much detail, but suffice to say whatever has been spoken about lower Caratage, there is a GC Max program, there are sourcing strategies, etcetera.

items.statement: The retail jewellery category is experiencing an increase in the number of brands, stores, and players, which drives competitive intensity.
items.quote: As far as competitive intensity goes in -- I mean, we are all aware of number of brands, number of stores, number of players that are increasing in the category.

items.statement: Discounting practices persist across the industry, varying by market context and segment.
items.quote: And discounting is something that keeps happening, which is different in different markets based on the context of that market and also the segment.

items.statement: The overall market has performed very well during the quarter.
items.quote: The market also has done very well. I wouldn't get too carried away by that.

items.statement: The highly uncertain trajectory of gold prices presents a risk to market behavior.
items.quote: Market is behaving in a particular manner. Gold prices continue to remain on a very uncertain trajectory.

items.statement: Geopolitical conflicts and war pose a risk to consumer purchasing priorities in international markets like Dubai and Saudi Arabia.
items.quote: But given the current situation of war, I think purchasing jewellery in Dubai and Saudi and other countries is the last priority for anyone there.

items.statement: Confusing news and market volatility can cause consumers to delay their purchases and wait on the sidelines.
items.quote: So, a lot of confusing news that people were exposed to during the month of May, and that kind of puts people back to the fence and they tend to wait it out.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: We think we are on trajectory for delivering the kind of growths that we had promised in the Investor Day. And we hope that we can, in fact, better it in the current year because we've started very well.
